Description

The Emily Tank Top is a fine-knit layer made to be worn close to the skin. Wider shoulder straps give extra coverage and warmth, and it layers neatly under blouses and jumpers.

Cotton gives softness and breathability, wool adds warmth and a touch of silk makes it feel smooth against the skin.

Material & care

Composition: 48% Cotton 44% Wool 8% Silk

Hand wash in cool water with a mild wool or silk detergent. Don't wring; dry flat away from direct heat. Always check the care label.

Size & fit

Close, second-skin fit in S, M and L. Between sizes or prefer a looser layer? Size up. Exchanges to another size are free of hassle within 14 days.

Delivery & returns

Free delivery within Norway in 2–5 business days with Posten. Orders ship Monday–Friday. Returns and size exchanges within 14 days of delivery. Full policy
